## INTEGER_LIMITS variable

Inclusive bounds of the SDK integer domain: the safe integers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
INTEGER_LIMITS: Readonly<{
  min: number
  max: number
}>
```

## Remarks

Values outside these bounds are rejected rather than clamped or rounded, in both directions across the wire and at the native boundary. An app may declare narrower bounds of its own; it can never widen these.
